trace.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
trace.evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code

attempts.sql:
SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 0 AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 0 AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The school with the lowest excellence rate is located at 2607 Myrtle Street, Oakland, CA 94607-3415.
